pages.text: Draconic, Legendary, Witheria and Mutated bees each carry a living aura that pulses from their hive while they work - the pulse radius comes straight from the bee's own Territory gene, so anything that widens territory widens the aura too.

pages.title: Aura Charms
pages.text: Craft the matching propolis into a charm to carry an aura with you instead of leaving it at the hive. A charm has limited charge - each pulse costs one point of durability, and when it runs out the charm breaks.
There's a fifth aura too: Harvest, carried by the Carrot bee, which fertilizes nearby crops like bonemeal. It has no matching propolis, so its charm is still crafted from a Carrot comb.
